digest.en: A Russian FSB hacker faces 10 years in a US prison after traveling to Thailand, while China's desert mock-up rehearses a US warship's death at sea. In the Middle East, Trump will attend the FIFA World Cup final, as the US and Iran engage in a cycle of attacks and diplomacy.

articles.title: Russian Fuel Shortages Trigger Fights, Public Anger

articles.title: WHO warns DR Congo Ebola outbreak is outpacing response as Uganda reaches milestone
articles.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has become the third largest on record and is spreading faster than any previous one during the first month of exposure, the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) warned on Thursday. articles.title: Ukrainians Rally Against Dismissal Of Popular Defense Minister
articles.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's sacking of Ukraine's popular defense minister, Mykhaylo Fedorov, is not just a dramatic shakeup of his cabinet. articles.title: The Shadowy Iranian Judge Sending Protesters To Their Death
articles.summary: Iran has executed some 40 political prisoners since mass protests rocked the country in January. articles.title: New guidance offers hope for reducing the global toll of dementia
articles.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has issued updated global guidelines aimed at reducing the risk of cognitive decline and dementia, saying that up to 45 per cent of cases may be preventable or delayed by addressing modifiable risk factors throughout life. New guidance offers hope for reducing the global toll of dementia.

articles.title: Skills for an uncertain future: How youth can navigate a changing job market

articles.summary: अमेरिकी सीनेट ने सैंक्शनिंग रशिया एक्ट 2026″ नामक नए विधेयक का समर्थन किया है, जिसमें भारत समेत पांच देशों पर 100 प्रतिशत तक टैरिफ लगाने का प्रस्ताव है। Sanctioning Russia Act 2026: मीडिल ईस्ट में तनाव के तनाव के बीच अमेरिका में रूस से तेल खरीदने वाले देशों पर सख्त कार्रवाई की तैयारी तेज हो गई है। इसको लेकर अमेरिकी सीनेट के 60 सांसदों ने सैंक्शनिंग रशिया एक्ट 2026″ (Sanctioning Russia Act 2026) नामक नए विधेयक का समर्थन किया है।
